How it works

From external change
to a plan you can review.

Clinical Operations, Supply and Quality can see what changed, which studies and shipments it affects, and who reviews the proposed response.

Detect the change

Capture the source, effective date and evidence behind a regulatory update. Monitoring is expanding to weather and transport disruptions.

Assess the impact

Match the change to affected studies, sites, batches and shipments. See which plans need attention before the next dispatch.

Compare responses

Review candidate actions such as reallocating stock, relabelling kits or changing a route. See which constraints each option meets and what still needs approval.

Interactive walkthrough

When a trial plan has to change.

Choose a disruption, compare two responses and inspect the checks behind the recommendation.

UK labelling rules change

A new labelling requirement puts the next UK dispatch at risk. The study team needs to confirm which kits can be used.

Sample data
Compare responses

Inspect evidence and checks

Validation

Designed to support validation.

Review the source, the checks applied to the recommendation, and the decision in one traceable workflow.

Trace the source

Review the original passage, source version and effective date alongside the proposed change.

Reproduce the checks

Fixed rules check AI-generated drafts and response options. Failures and missing inputs are visible to the reviewer.

Record who decided and why

Role-based approval and an audit trail record decisions. Execution remains subject to approval in the relevant system. Each organization validates the workflow for its intended use.
